{{Quote|Soon after arriving in the Krant system, strange signals were received from the supposedly abandoned moon of Aereen.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="GB:CC" />}}
The '''Krant system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The Krant system was the site of the [[Krantian Civil War]].<ref name="GB" />
